# ligo_binding (Resource)

A binding: the access that a source has to a target. Every change is a change request that the provider files once and waits for, and then waits until the binding is ACTIVE; it never approves a request, never lifts a hold and never retries a failed binding. Removal revokes the access. The parameters name credentials by reference, never by value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The access that a source has to a target. Owned by this automation (the lock).
# The apply waits until the binding is ACTIVE; removal revokes the access.
# The parameters name credentials by reference, never by value.
resource "ligo_binding" "ledger_app_reads" {
  name         = "ledger-app-reads-ledger-db"
  source       = ligo_source.ledger_app.name
  target       = ligo_target.ledger.name
  access_level = "read"
  purpose      = "Month-end reports"
  expires_at   = "2027-06-30T00:00:00Z"

  parameters = jsonencode({
    connectionLimit = 5
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_level` (String) The access level of the target that is granted.
- `name` (String) The name; a new name is a new resource.
- `source` (String) The source that is given the access; a binding does not move to another.
- `target` (String) The target that is reached; a binding does not move to another.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) When the binding expires, as an RFC 3339 time.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether this automation owns it (the lock): only the owner then changes it. Default: the provider's managed. false, on one that is managed, is the owner's release.
- `parameters` (String) The parameters of the access, as JSON text (jsonencode); the platform's form says which. They are checked against it when the plan can read it. When the configuration has none, they are what the platform defaults to, as ligo answers them.
- `purpose` (String) Why the binding exists.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The name.
- `last_change_request` (String) The ID of the last change request the provider filed or waited for.
- `managed_by` (String) The SPIFFE ID of the automation that owns it; null when nobody does.
- `phase` (String) PROVISIONING, ACTIVE, FAILED, DELETING or DELETE_FAILED.
- `phase_message` (String) The last message of the workflow that provisions the binding.
- `revision` (Number) The revision; an update names it, and ligo refuses a stale one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By name. The first plan after the import shows what the configuration changes.
terraform import ligo_binding.ledger_app_reads ledger-app-reads-ledger-db
```
